delegate.routingGuidance: Choose the cheapest eligible Luna route for bounded work with a known finish line; use Astra low when the delegate must discover the path or exercise substantial judgement. Do not escalate speculatively.

luna-low.useFor: Fully mechanical bounded work with one deterministic answer and an exact verifier.
luna-low.avoid: Discovery, judgement, or an undecided finish line.

luna-medium.useFor: Bounded work with a failing test or exact specification, such as one invariant, fix, or localized subsystem change.
luna-medium.avoid: Open-ended review, cross-subsystem work, security reasoning, or choosing the design or finish line.

luna-high.useFor: Bounded implementation or review with known architecture, scope, criteria, and files; established multi-file work fits.
luna-high.avoid: Short deadlines, open-ended judgement, broad high-stakes review, or sustained cross-subsystem exploration.

luna-xhigh.useFor: Difficult bounded implementation, diagnosis, regression review, or security verification across files or subsystems with explicit acceptance criteria or named security invariants.
luna-xhigh.avoid: Foreground deadline work, unclear criteria needing maintainer judgement, or unbounded repository-wide review.

luna-max.useFor: Difficult bounded work expected to need unusually deep exploration or verification.
luna-max.avoid: Short deadlines, interactive foreground work, no bounded finish line, or using depth to replace route judgement.

astra-low.useFor: Difficult work where the child must discover the path: ambiguous diagnosis, broad exploration, architecture or design judgement, adversarial review, security reasoning, or an emerging finish line.
astra-low.avoid: Bounded work a cheaper route can execute or verify reliably, or trivial mechanical work.
